description: This file contains the implementation of an LDAP Authentication Provider class in PHP for the OrangeHRM project. It handles LDAP authentication processes, including binding to LDAP services, user synchronization, and credential verification.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: A class that implements LDAP authentication logic, extending AbstractAuthProvider and utilizing LDAP services for user authentication.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LDAPService.

methods.name: getLDAPSyncService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LDAPSyncService.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of AuthenticationService.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs LDAP authentication by binding to LDAP with user credentials and setting user credentials upon successful bind.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the authentication provider, here set to 5000.
